groups.script:
Woman: Hello, Mr. Kowalski? This is Rachel Tan from Brightwater Engineering. I'm calling about your application for the project coordinator position.
Man: Oh, hello. Thanks for calling.
Woman: Our hiring team was impressed with your résumé, and we'd like to invite you for an interview next Tuesday at two.
Man: I'd be glad to come in, but I'm traveling for work on Tuesday. Would Wednesday be possible?
Woman: Wednesday afternoon is fully booked, but we could do ten a.m.
Man: That's perfect. Should I bring anything?
Woman: Please bring a portfolio of projects you've managed. I'll email you directions to our office as well.

questions.prompt: Why is the woman calling?
choices: To offer the man a job
questions.explain: Cô ấy gọi về đơn ứng tuyển và mời anh đến phỏng vấn ("invite you for an interview"), rồi hai bên chốt lịch.

questions.prompt: Why is the man unavailable on Tuesday?
choices: He will be on a business trip.
questions.explain: Anh ấy nói "I'm traveling for work on Tuesday" — thứ Ba đi công tác.

questions.prompt: What does the woman ask the man to bring?
questions.explain: Cô ấy dặn mang theo hồ sơ các dự án anh từng quản lý ("a portfolio of projects you've managed"), tức là ví dụ công việc trước đây.

groups.context:
Halston Tower — Directory
Floor 2: Customer Service
Floor 3: Accounting
Floor 4: Human Resources
Floor 5: Legal Department
groups.script:
Man: Hi, I'm here to drop off some signed contracts for Ms. Delgado. I was told she's on the third floor.
Woman: She used to be, but the legal team moved upstairs last month after the renovation.
Man: Oh, I see. Is it all right if I go up directly?
Woman: You'll need a visitor badge first. Can I see some identification, please?
Man: Sure, here's my driver's license. I'm from Fenwick Couriers.
Woman: Thank you. Here's your badge. Please return it to this desk when you leave.

questions.prompt: Who most likely is the man?
questions.explain: Anh ấy đến giao hợp đồng đã ký và nói mình làm ở Fenwick Couriers (công ty chuyển phát) — tức là người giao hàng.

questions.prompt: Look at the graphic. Which floor will the man go to?
questions.explain: Bà Delgado thuộc nhóm pháp lý, đã chuyển lên trên; theo bảng chỉ dẫn, phòng Pháp lý (Legal Department) ở tầng 5.

questions.prompt: What does the woman ask the man for before giving him a badge?
questions.explain: Trước khi đưa thẻ khách, cô ấy hỏi "Can I see some identification, please?" — yêu cầu giấy tờ tùy thân.

groups.script:
Woman: Jonas, have you seen the figures from the spring campaign? Website traffic is up nearly forty percent.
Man: I have. Mind you, online sales have barely moved.
Woman: Right, so people are visiting the site but not buying. I wonder if the checkout process is putting them off.
Man: Could be. Customer feedback mentions that shipping costs only show up at the very last step.
Woman: That would explain it. Let's propose displaying shipping costs on the product pages instead.
Man: I'll pull together the feedback data so we can present it at Monday's meeting.

questions.prompt: What does the man mean when he says, "Mind you, online sales have barely moved"?
choices: He thinks the traffic figures are wrong.
He wants to end the campaign early.
The campaign results are not entirely positive.
The sales staff need more training.
questions.explain: "Mind you" dùng để nêu một điểm trái ngược: lượt truy cập tăng nhưng doanh số gần như không đổi, nên kết quả không hoàn toàn tốt.

questions.prompt: According to the man, what do customers complain about?
choices: Shipping costs appearing only at the end
questions.explain: Anh ấy nói phản hồi khách hàng cho biết phí vận chuyển chỉ hiện ở bước cuối cùng ("only show up at the very last step").

questions.prompt: What will the man do before the meeting?
questions.explain: Anh ấy nói sẽ tổng hợp dữ liệu phản hồi ("pull together the feedback data") để trình bày trong cuộc họp thứ Hai.

groups.script:
Woman: Good evening. I have a reservation under the name Ines Moreau.
Man: Welcome, Ms. Moreau. I see you're staying with us for two nights. Here is your key card. Your room is 512.
Woman: Thank you. My flight home isn't until Sunday evening. Is it possible to check out late?
Man: Our standard checkout time is eleven, but we can extend it to two o'clock for a fee of twenty euros.
Woman: That's fine. Also, what time is breakfast served?
Man: From six thirty to ten in the restaurant on the ground floor.

questions.prompt: Where does the conversation most likely take place?
questions.explain: Người phụ nữ nhận phòng, được đưa thẻ khóa phòng 512 và hỏi giờ trả phòng — đây là quầy lễ tân khách sạn.

questions.prompt: What does the woman request?
questions.explain: Vì chuyến bay tối Chủ nhật, cô xin trả phòng muộn ("Is it possible to check out late?").

questions.prompt: What time does breakfast end?
questions.explain: Bữa sáng phục vụ từ 6 giờ 30 đến 10 giờ ("From six thirty to ten"); 11 giờ và 2 giờ là giờ trả phòng.

groups.script:
Woman 1: Before we finish, Hiroshi, can you update us on the new accounting software?
Man: Sure. Installation on all computers will be done by Thursday. Starting next week, everyone should use the new system for expense reports.
Woman 2: Will there be any training? Some of my team members are worried about learning it quickly.
Man: Yes, the vendor is running two online sessions on Monday, one at nine and one at three. Each takes about an hour.
Woman 1: Great. Could you send everyone the links for both sessions today?
Man: I'll do that right after this meeting.

questions.prompt: What is the main topic of the conversation?
questions.explain: Cuộc trao đổi nói về việc cài đặt và chuyển sang phần mềm kế toán mới cho báo cáo chi phí.

questions.prompt: What concern does the second woman mention?
choices: Her team may struggle to learn the system quickly.
The installation costs are too high.
questions.explain: Woman 2 nói một số thành viên nhóm lo không học kịp hệ thống mới ("worried about learning it quickly").

questions.prompt: What will the man do after the meeting?
questions.explain: Được nhờ gửi đường link hai buổi đào tạo, anh ấy đáp "I'll do that right after this meeting".

groups.context:
Greenleaf Catering — Lunch Packages (per person)
Basic: $14
Classic: $18
Premium: $24
Deluxe: $30
groups.script:
Woman: Hi, it's Mei from Orbis Design. We'd like to order lunch for our board meeting on the twelfth.
Man: Certainly. How many guests, and which package are you interested in?
Woman: Twenty-two people. I was looking at the Premium package, but my manager said to keep it under twenty dollars a person.
Man: Then I'd suggest the package just below Premium. It includes sandwiches, a salad, fruit, and drinks.
Woman: That sounds good. Several guests are vegetarian, though.
Man: Not a problem. Just let me know the exact number of vegetarians by Friday, and we'll prepare special sandwiches for them.

questions.prompt: Why is the woman calling?
choices: To order food for a meeting
questions.explain: Cô ấy gọi để đặt bữa trưa cho cuộc họp hội đồng quản trị ngày 12 ("order lunch for our board meeting").

questions.prompt: Look at the graphic. How much will the woman's company most likely pay per person?
questions.explain: Người bán gợi ý gói ngay dưới Premium, theo bảng là Classic giá 18 đô — đúng yêu cầu dưới 20 đô một người.

questions.prompt: What does the man ask the woman to do by Friday?
choices: Give the number of vegetarian guests
questions.explain: Anh ấy dặn báo số khách ăn chay chính xác trước thứ Sáu ("let me know the exact number of vegetarians by Friday").

groups.script:
Man: Have you read the memo about the hybrid work policy? Starting in March, we'll only need to be in the office three days a week.
Woman: I did. I'm all for it, but I'm not sure how we'll manage the client workshops. Those really need everyone in the same room.
Man: The memo says each team can choose its own office days, so we could just schedule the workshops on those days.
Woman: Fair enough. But with fewer people coming in, I heard management is thinking about giving up the fourth floor.
Man: That's still under discussion. Apparently, they'll survey staff before making any decision.
Woman: Well, I'll definitely be filling that out.

questions.prompt: What change does the memo announce?
choices: A move to a new building
Fewer required days in the office
questions.explain: Theo bản ghi nhớ, từ tháng Ba nhân viên chỉ cần lên văn phòng ba ngày một tuần — tức là ít ngày bắt buộc hơn.

questions.prompt: What concern does the woman raise first?
questions.explain: Cô ấy lo không biết tổ chức các buổi workshop với khách hàng thế nào vì cần mọi người có mặt cùng phòng.

questions.prompt: What does the woman imply when she says, "I'll definitely be filling that out"?
choices: She has already sent a complaint.
She wants to apply for a transfer.
She disagrees with the hybrid policy.
She intends to respond to the staff survey.
questions.explain: "That" chỉ cuộc khảo sát nhân viên vừa được nhắc; cô ấy ngụ ý chắc chắn sẽ điền khảo sát để nêu ý kiến về việc bỏ tầng bốn.
